title: Creating a Basic Spider 🕷
ques: Define a simple Scrapy Spider class named `MySpider` that inherits from `scrapy.Spider` and sets the `name` to `'myspider'`.
explanation: A Spider requires a unique `name`, a list of `start_urls`, and a `parse` method to handle the downloaded response.

title: Yielding Data 📦
ques: Inside a Scrapy `parse` method, write the code to extract the text of a `<title>` tag and yield it as a dictionary.
explanation: Spiders should `yield` dictionaries or Scrapy Items. Scrapy uses CSS selectors heavily for efficient extraction.

title: Following Links 🔗
ques: Write a line of code in Scrapy to follow a link stored in the variable `next_page` and pass the response to a callback named `self.parse`.
explanation: `response.follow` provides a convenient way to construct a new Request from relative URLs.
